pgx_exclusion_reason: Local PGx join leaves controls near-zero on pgx_has_any_drug while cases are 100%; excluded so utilization ablation is not confounded by broken PGx coverage.
caveat: Matched local with-util AUPRC approaches 1.0 because utilization-density/temporal features dominate this aggregate rebuild; that illustrates why the primary manuscript uses density stratification. Util-free absolute AUPRC should be compared chiefly to manuscript holdout AUPRC (0.301) and judged by drug/interaction persistence rather than by matching the pathological with-util score.
response_letter_blurb: We refit the non-opioid ED 65–74 model after dropping 17 utilization-derived covariates (density ordinal, event-rate, inter-event gap, recency, and burstiness). On the 2019 holdout, util-free AUPRC was 0.0578 (PR lift 2.035×) versus the manuscript primary of 0.301. Top-25 drug contribution overlap Jaccard versus the matched with-util comparator was 0.1111; intersection included item_drug_ALLOPURINOL, item_drug_GABAPENTIN, item_drug_LISINOPRIL, item_drug_OMEPRAZOLE, item_drug_SIMVASTATIN. 3/5 manuscript-highlighted synergistic pairs retained a positive interaction contrast under the util-free model, supporting persistence of key drug-interaction signals after utilization removal.
